title: Meta Inverse Prompting for Video Generative Models
title_zh: 面向视频生成模型的元逆提示方法

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled flexible conditional generation and editing pipelines, such as text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-guided synthesis. However, these workflows are inherently one-directional, mapping conditions to videos without providing a mechanism to invert this process. In complex media production settings, the ability to recover controllable textual conditions from a given video is highly desirable, yet remains underexplored. While inverse prompting has been studied for image generation, directly extending these approaches to video is challenging due to the need to capture temporal dynamics beyond static appearance, as well as the substantial computational cost of per-video optimization. In this work, we propose the first practical framework for efficient video inverse prompting. Specifically, we formulate inverse prompting as a meta-learning problem and introduce Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP), which learns a meta-prompt optimized over temporal dimensions to enable fast and effective prompt inference. Our approach amortizes the inversion process, eliminating the need for costly iterative optimization at test time. Experimental results demonstrate that MVIP recovers higher-quality inverse prompts with significantly improved reconstruction fidelity compared to image-based inversion and iterative captioning baselines, while achieving substantial gains in efficiency. Code and video results are available at https://ueriniuno.github.io/mvip-page/ .

paragraphs.en: Video generative models have rapidly advanced to produce high-quality and temporally coherent videos, approaching realistic visual fidelity across diverse scenes and motions [ 62 , 60 , 70 ] . These models are increasingly deployed across a wide range of applications, including content creation [ 44 , 57 ] , editing [ 68 , 74 , 15 , 36 ] , simulation [ 7 , 69 ] , and world modeling [ 2 , 7 , 11 ] . To support such applications, modern video generation frameworks support flexible conditional pipelines such as text-to-video [ 55 , 62 , 70 ] , image-to-video [ 5 , 9 , 60 ] , and reference-guided synthesis [ 31 , 75 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型已迅速发展，能够生成高质量且时间上连贯的视频，在多样的场景和动作中接近真实的视觉保真度 [62, 60, 70]。 这些模型越来越多地被部署于广泛的应用中，包括内容创作 [44, 57]、编辑 [68, 74, 15, 36]、仿真 [7, 69] 以及世界建模 [2, 7, 11]。 为支持此类应用，现代视频生成框架支持灵活的条件化流程，例如文生视频 [55, 62, 70]、图生视频 [5, 9, 60] 以及参考引导的合成 [31, 75]。

paragraphs.en: However, despite this progress, existing workflows to access video generative models are inherently “unidirectional”; viz ., while conditions can effectively guide video synthesis, they lack a clear mechanism to invert this process, e . g ., for fine-grained semantic controls. For example, a creator may generate a video from a prompt and later wish to modify it, such as changing lighting or motion while preserving the scene. However, the original prompt is often unavailable or insufficient to reproduce the video due to the non-unique and model-dependent nature of prompt-video mappings, forcing users to rely on trial-and-error prompt engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，尽管取得了这些进展，现有的访问视频生成模型的工作流程本质上是“单向的”；即，虽然条件可以有效引导视频合成，但缺乏一种清晰的机制来反转这一过程，例如用于细粒度的语义控制。 例如，创作者可能根据提示词生成了一个视频，之后希望对其进行修改，比如在保留场景的同时改变光照或运动。 然而，由于提示词与视频之间的映射具有非唯一性且依赖于具体模型，原始提示词往往不可用或不足以复现该视频，迫使用户依赖反复试错的提示词工程。

paragraphs.en: This motivates the problem of inverse prompting , which aims to recover a textual prompt that can faithfully reproduce a given target video under a generative model. Prior work on inverse prompting has largely focused on images [ 65 , 38 , 50 ] , primarily relying on gradient-based optimization or iterative captioning strategies. However, these approaches do not scale well to video. Gradient-based methods [ 65 , 38 ] require repeated forward and backward passes during target-specific prompt optimization, which becomes prohibitively expensive for long video sequences. Captioning-based approaches [ 50 ] , on the other hand, often produce semantically plausible but insufficient prompts to support reconstruction, as videos require capturing not only per-frame appearance but also temporal dynamics and coherence across frames, e . g ., action sequences, motion trajectories, and camera movements. Consequently, directly applying existing methods to video results in a poor trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency, while the problem itself remains largely unexplored in the video domain. As shown in Figure 1 , our goal is to recover a reusable prompt from a target video, enabling both faithful video reconstruction and controllable prompt-based video editing.
paragraphs.zh: 这引出了逆提示（inverse prompting）问题，其目标是在生成模型下恢复一个能够忠实再现给定目标视频的文本提示。 以往关于逆提示的工作主要集中在图像领域 [65, 38, 50]，主要依赖基于梯度的优化或迭代式描述生成策略。 然而，这些方法难以很好地扩展到视频。 基于梯度的方法 [65, 38] 在针对特定目标的提示优化过程中需要反复进行前向和后向计算，对于长视频序列而言代价高得令人望而却步。 另一方面，基于描述生成的方法 [50] 往往会产生语义上看似合理但不足以支持重建的提示，因为视频不仅需要捕捉每帧的外观，还需要捕捉时间动态和帧间的一致性，例如动作序列、运动轨迹和摄像机运动。 因此，将现有方法直接应用于视频会导致重建保真度与计算效率之间的糟糕权衡，而该问题本身在视频领域也基本未被探索。 如图 1 所示，我们的目标是从目标视频中恢复一个可复用的提示，从而实现忠实的视频重建和基于提示的可控视频编辑。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP), the first practical framework for video inverse prompting, to the best of our knowledge. Our key idea is to unify gradient-based optimization and captioning-based approaches within a meta-learning [ 16 , 39 ] formulation, achieving both high reconstruction fidelity and efficiency. Instead of optimizing prompts from scratch for each video, we cast inverse prompting as a meta-learning that learns a shared prompt initialization across videos. During meta-training, MVIP performs gradient-based prompt optimization over diverse videos, allowing the meta-prompt to capture common spatiotemporal structures required for faithful reconstruction. At inference time, this learned initialization enables rapid prompt inference without costly per-video optimization, effectively behaving as a reconstruction-aware captioning mechanism. In this way, MVIP combines the reconstruction fidelity of gradient-based methods with the efficiency of captioning-based approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了元视频逆向提示（Meta Video Inverse Prompting，MVIP），据我们所知，这是首个实用的视频逆向提示框架。 我们的核心思想是将基于梯度的优化方法与基于描述生成的方法统一到元学习 [16, 39] 的框架中，同时实现高重建保真度和高效率。 我们不再为每个视频从零开始优化提示，而是将逆向提示转化为一种元学习，即学习一个在多个视频间共享的提示初始化。 在元训练阶段，MVIP 在多样化的视频上进行基于梯度的提示优化，使元提示能够捕获忠实重建所需的共同时空结构。 在推理阶段，这一学到的初始化使得无需对每个视频进行代价高昂的优化即可快速完成提示推断，实际上表现为一种具备重建感知能力的描述生成机制。 通过这种方式，MVIP 结合了基于梯度方法的重建保真度与基于描述生成方法的效率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MVIP on both real and synthetic videos, including videos generated from diverse video generative models, to assess its generality across different video distributions and generation pipelines. Since video inverse prompting remains largely unexplored and lacks established benchmarks or baselines, we construct practical comparison methods based on recent image inverse prompting approaches, including PEZ [ 65 ] and ARPO [ 50 ] , as well as captioning-based methods. The results demonstrate that MVIP consistently achieves superior reconstruction performance across diverse video-video and video-text alignment metrics. Notably, our method significantly outperforms iterative captioning approaches despite requiring substantially lower computational cost, showing that high-quality inverse prompting cannot be achieved by simply increasing inference-time iterations. Qualitative comparisons further show that our meta-learned initialization produces prompts that better capture temporal dynamics and fine-grained scene details, resulting in more faithful and controllable video reconstructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在真实视频和合成视频上评估 MVIP，包括由多种视频生成模型生成的视频，以评估其在不同视频分布和生成流程上的通用性。 由于视频逆提示（video inverse prompting）在很大程度上仍待探索，缺乏公认的基准或基线，我们基于近期的图像逆提示方法构建了实用的对比方法，包括 PEZ [65] 和 ARPO [50]，以及基于描述生成的方法。 结果表明，MVIP 在多样化的视频-视频和视频-文本对齐指标上始终取得更优的重建性能。 值得注意的是，尽管我们的方法显著优于迭代式描述生成方法，但其所需计算成本要低得多，这表明仅通过增加推理时的迭代次数无法实现高质量的逆提示。 定性比较进一步表明，我们通过元学习得到的初始化所生成的提示能更好地捕捉时间动态和细粒度场景细节，从而实现更忠实、更可控的视频重建。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation have been largely driven by text-to-video (T2V) frameworks, where diffusion models [ 6 , 62 , 60 ] , transformer architectures [ 21 , 20 ] , and flow-matching objectives [ 28 , 44 ] have enabled high-quality video synthesis from textual descriptions. Alongside open research models [ 9 , 28 , 33 , 60 , 70 ] , commercial systems [ 40 , 52 , 19 ] have further established video generation as a practical tool for content creation. This progress has extended video generation beyond T2V to conditional interfaces such as image-to-video generation [ 72 , 35 , 22 , 37 ] , reference-guided synthesis [ 26 , 67 ] , and text-driven editing [ 46 , 34 , 61 ] . Here, prompts serve not only as semantic descriptions but also as control signals that guide visual content, motion, and editing.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成领域的最新进展很大程度上是由文本生成视频（T2V）框架驱动的，其中扩散模型 [ 6 , 62 , 60 ]、Transformer 架构 [ 21 , 20 ] 以及流匹配目标 [ 28 , 44 ] 使得从文本描述合成高质量视频成为可能。 除了开放的研究模型 [ 9 , 28 , 33 , 60 , 70 ] 之外，商业系统 [ 40 , 52 , 19 ] 也进一步确立了视频生成作为内容创作实用工具的地位。 这一进展已将视频生成从 T2V 扩展到各种条件化接口，例如图生视频 [ 72 , 35 , 22 , 37 ]、参考引导合成 [ 26 , 67 ] 以及文本驱动的编辑 [ 46 , 34 , 61 ] 。 在这里，提示词不仅作为语义描述，还充当引导视觉内容、运动和编辑的控制信号。

paragraphs.en: Recent video generative models have achieved substantial progress, yet their outputs remain highly sensitive to input conditions, including textual prompts and visual anchors. Minor variations in these conditions can lead to substantially different visual outputs [ 25 , 73 ] . Existing prompt inversion methods have mainly focused on images, including pseudo-word embedding learning [ 18 ] , model fine-tuning with unique identifiers [ 51 ] , gradient-based hard-prompt optimization [ 65 , 38 ] , and black-box prompt search [ 50 ] . While effective for static visual content, these methods are not directly suited to video, where the recovered prompt must account for temporal evolution in addition to appearance. In this paper, we address this inverse problem through a reconstruction-driven framework that recovers prompts directly from target videos.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频生成模型已取得显著进展，但其输出对输入条件仍然高度敏感，包括文本提示词和视觉锚点。 这些条件的细微变化可能导致截然不同的视觉输出 [ 25 , 73 ] 。 现有的提示词反演方法主要集中于图像，包括伪词嵌入学习 [ 18 ] 、使用唯一标识符的模型微调 [ 51 ] 、基于梯度的硬提示词优化 [ 65 , 38 ] 以及黑盒提示词搜索 [ 50 ] 。 尽管这些方法对静态视觉内容有效，但并不直接适用于视频，因为恢复出的提示词除了外观之外还必须考虑时间演化。 在本文中，我们通过一个由重建驱动的框架来解决这一反问题，该框架直接从目标视频中恢复提示词。

paragraphs.en: Meta-learning aims to extract transferable knowledge from a distribution of tasks so that a model can rapidly adapt to new tasks with limited data or optimization. Beyond metric-based methods [ 59 ] that learn shared embeddings and model-based approaches [ 54 ] that leverage memory, optimization-based meta-learning is a prominent paradigm. Notably, MAML [ 16 ] and Reptile [ 39 ] focus on learning an optimal initialization for rapid gradient-based adaptation. This paradigm has been widely adopted in domains where task-specific adaptation is costly, such as personalized federated learning [ 14 ] , few-shot image classification [ 32 , 53 ] , and natural language classification [ 4 ] . A similar initialization-based view has also been explored in prompt learning and prompt optimization. Meta prompt tuning learns transferable initializations for cross-task generalization [ 47 ] , while system prompt optimization uses a meta-learning framework to learn system prompts that generalize across diverse user inputs and unseen tasks [ 13 ] . These studies highlight the benefit of transferring task-level experience through learned prompt initializations. Building on this, we formulate video inverse prompting as a meta-learning problem, leveraging shared initializations to facilitate precise, reconstruction-oriented adaptation for each target video.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习旨在从任务分布中提取可迁移的知识，使模型能够在数据或优化有限的情况下快速适应新任务。 除了学习共享嵌入的基于度量的方法 [ 59 ] 和利用记忆的基于模型的方法 [ 54 ] 之外，基于优化的元学习是一种重要的范式。 值得注意的是，MAML [ 16 ] 和 Reptile [ 39 ] 专注于学习一个最优初始化，以实现快速的基于梯度的适应。 这一范式已被广泛应用于任务特定适应成本高昂的领域，例如个性化联邦学习 [ 14 ] 、少样本图像分类 [ 32 , 53 ] 以及自然语言分类 [ 4 ] 。 类似的基于初始化的视角也已在提示学习和提示优化中得到探索。 元提示调优学习可迁移的初始化以实现跨任务泛化 [ 47 ] ，而系统提示优化则使用元学习框架来学习能够泛化到多样化用户输入和未见任务的系统提示 [ 13 ] 。 这些研究凸显了通过学习到的提示初始化来迁移任务级经验的好处。 在此基础上，我们将视频逆向提示构建为一个元学习问题，利用共享初始化来促进针对每个目标视频的、面向重建的精确适应。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP), the first practical framework for video inverse prompting, to the best of our knowledge. Our key insight is that gradient-based prompt optimization for video reconstruction can be lifted into the instruction-prompt space within a vision-language model (VLM) and amortized via meta-learning, enabling it to directly generate reconstruction-aware prompts from unseen videos in a fast, captioning-like manner.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we evaluate MVIP on both real and synthetic video datasets. We compare MVIP with caption-based and image inverse prompting baselines to assess reconstruction fidelity, and analyze how meta-learned initialization affects the efficiency and quality of the reconstruction prompt. We also analyze the iterative refinement baseline to examine whether feedback-based updates provide additional gains over one-shot prompt generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们在真实与合成视频数据集上对 MVIP 进行评估。 我们将 MVIP 与基于描述和图像逆提示的基线方法进行比较，以评估重建保真度，并分析元学习初始化如何影响重建提示的效率与质量。 我们还分析了迭代优化基线，以考察基于反馈的更新能否比一次性提示生成带来额外收益。

paragraphs.en: In Table 1 , we first evaluate MVIP on held-out videos from datasets used during meta-training, covering both synthetic and real-world videos. MVIP achieves the best overall performance in both domains. Specifically, in the synthetic video subset, MVIP consistently achieves higher scores than existing methods, including VLM-based captioning and iterative refinement. In the real-world video domain, MVIP increases the ViCLIP V-V score to 0.8328, compared to 0.8047 achieved by the 3-step iterative refinement baseline. To further evaluate generalizability beyond the meta-training datasets, we evaluate MVIP on two unseen test sets, Kinetics-400 [ 27 ] and DAVIS-2017 [ 42 , 45 ] , without changing the learned meta-prompt or any other training procedure. MVIP achieves the best performance on most metrics across both datasets, suggesting that the learned meta-prompt generalizes well to previously unseen video distributions. As shown in Table 4 , iterative refinement provides only modest gains at substantially higher computational cost while remaining below MVIP in reconstruction quality. Overall, these results show that MVIP improves the quality-efficiency trade-off by reducing reliance on costly test-time refinement. We further report text-alignment results in Appendix F.5 .

paragraphs.en: To evaluate MVIP against stronger captioning baselines, we conduct experiments on MSR-VTT [ 66 ] , replacing Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 3 ] with Qwen3.5-9B [ 48 ] and using a more detailed instruction covering visual and temporal content. paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of MVIP in downstream video editing, we consider the subject-motion editing tasks of IVEBench [ 12 ] as a representative downstream editing benchmark. We follow its evaluation protocol and compare MVIP with two video editing methods: RF-Edit [ 61 ] , an inversion-based editing framework for rectified-flow models, and Wan-Edit [ 30 ] , a training-free video editing method for the Wan model family. For MVIP, we use GPT-4o [ 24 ] to minimally rewrite the recovered inverse prompt according to the edit instruction and check whether the requested motion is reflected in the edited prompt. The edited prompt and only the first frame of the source video are then used for video generation, without access to the benchmark target prompt or any editing-specific training.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 MVIP 在下游视频编辑中的有效性，我们将 IVEBench [12] 的主体—运动编辑任务作为代表性的下游编辑基准。 我们遵循其评估协议，将 MVIP 与两种视频编辑方法进行比较：RF-Edit [61]，一种针对整流扩散模型（rectified-flow models）的基于反演的编辑框架；以及 Wan-Edit [30]，一种面向 Wan 模型家族的无训练视频编辑方法。 对于 MVIP，我们使用 GPT-4o [24] 根据编辑指令对恢复出的反向提示词进行最小幅度的改写，并检查所请求的运动是否体现在编辑后的提示词中。 然后仅使用编辑后的提示词和源视频的第一帧进行视频生成，不访问基准的目标提示词，也不进行任何针对编辑的专门训练。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 6 , despite requiring no editing-specific training, the MVIP-based prompt editing pipeline achieves the highest Instruction Satisfaction and Content Fidelity while remaining competitive across the other metrics. In particular, MVIP remains competitive with RF-Edit [ 61 ] , which is built upon a substantially larger video model with an RF solver, and Wan-Edit [ 30 ] , which is specifically designed for editing within the same model family. These results show that inverse prompts recovered for reconstruction can also serve as effective control interfaces for downstream video editing. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 further illustrates that simple textual modification of the recovered inverse prompt can induce the intended motion changes in the generated video. For the instruction “Make the man and the boy suddenly fall asleep,” MVIP progressively changes their postures, with the man reclining backward and the boy lowering his head, while preserving the source scene and overall composition. Compared with MVIP, RF-Edit [ 61 ] shows greater changes in subject appearance and scene content in later frames, while Wan-Edit [ 30 ] reflects the requested sleeping motion less clearly. Table 7 further shows how the recovered inverse prompt is modified according to the edit instruction. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we have presented MVIP, a meta-learning framework for recovering inverse prompts from videos. While prior inverse prompting methods focus on images, we show that video inverse prompting requires a different approach due to temporal dynamics and the high cost of video optimization. Through comparisons with baselines, we show that MVIP improves video reconstruction using only a compact set of meta-learned soft tokens, without updating the VLM or the video generator. These results suggest that video inverse prompting can be effectively amortized through a learned prompt prior, which provides a reusable initialization for retaining scene context and temporal cues.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 MVIP，一个用于从视频中恢复逆向提示词的元学习框架。 以往的逆向提示方法主要针对图像，我们展示了由于时间动态特性以及视频优化的高成本，视频逆向提示需要一种不同的方法。 通过与基线方法的比较，我们表明 MVIP 仅使用一组紧凑的元学习软令牌即可改善视频重建，而无需更新 VLM 或视频生成器。 这些结果表明，视频逆向提示可以通过学习到的提示先验得到有效摊销，该先验为保留场景上下文和时间线索提供了可复用的初始化。

paragraphs.en: While our work demonstrates the feasibility of practical video inverse prompting, several aspects remain beyond the scope of the current framework. In particular, the proposed method assumes a first-last-frame (FLF) conditioning setup, where the boundary frames of the target video are provided. This design choice allows the model to focus on learning temporally coherent inverse prompting beyond static appearance reconstruction, and is also motivated by the fact that many recent public video generative models support FLF-conditioned generation. Nevertheless, the current framework does not address fully text-only video inverse prompting, which remains a challenging open problem due to the severe ambiguity of prompt-video mappings in the video domain. Despite this limitation, the proposed approach can still serve as a practical component within broader media generation pipelines when combined with existing image-based inverse prompting and editing methods. In addition, further developments may be required for deployment in real-world media production workflows. For example, learning more structured and editable captioning schemas through meta-learning could improve controllability and downstream editing flexibility, which we view as a promising direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们的工作展示了实用化视频反向提示的可行性，但仍有一些方面超出了当前框架的范围。 具体而言，所提出的方法假设首尾帧（FLF）条件设置，即提供目标视频的边界帧。 这一设计选择使模型能够专注于学习超越静态外观重建的时间连贯的反向提示，其动机也在于近期许多公开的视频生成模型都支持 FLF 条件生成。 尽管如此，当前框架并未解决完全纯文本的视频反向提示问题；由于视频领域中提示与视频之间映射的严重歧义性，这仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。 尽管存在这一局限，所提出的方法在与现有的基于图像的反向提示和编辑方法结合时，仍可作为更广泛的媒体生成流程中的一个实用组件。 此外，要在真实世界的媒体制作工作流中部署，可能还需要进一步的开发。 例如，通过元学习来学习更结构化、更可编辑的描述模式，可以提高可控性和下游编辑的灵活性，我们将此视为未来工作的一个有前景的方向。

sents.en: While our work demonstrates the feasibility of practical video inverse prompting, several aspects remain beyond the scope of the current framework.
sents.zh: 尽管我们的工作展示了实用化视频反向提示的可行性，但仍有一些方面超出了当前框架的范围。

sents.en: In particular, the proposed method assumes a first-last-frame (FLF) conditioning setup, where the boundary frames of the target video are provided.
sents.zh: 具体而言，所提出的方法假设首尾帧（FLF）条件设置，即提供目标视频的边界帧。

sents.en: This design choice allows the model to focus on learning temporally coherent inverse prompting beyond static appearance reconstruction, and is also motivated by the fact that many recent public video generative models support FLF-conditioned generation.
sents.zh: 这一设计选择使模型能够专注于学习超越静态外观重建的时间连贯的反向提示，其动机也在于近期许多公开的视频生成模型都支持 FLF 条件生成。

sents.en: Nevertheless, the current framework does not address fully text-only video inverse prompting, which remains a challenging open problem due to the severe ambiguity of prompt-video mappings in the video domain.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，当前框架并未解决完全纯文本的视频反向提示问题；由于视频领域中提示与视频之间映射的严重歧义性，这仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。

sents.en: Despite this limitation, the proposed approach can still serve as a practical component within broader media generation pipelines when combined with existing image-based inverse prompting and editing methods.
sents.zh: 尽管存在这一局限，所提出的方法在与现有的基于图像的反向提示和编辑方法结合时，仍可作为更广泛的媒体生成流程中的一个实用组件。

sents.en: In addition, further developments may be required for deployment in real-world media production workflows.
sents.zh: 此外，要在真实世界的媒体制作工作流中部署，可能还需要进一步的开发。

sents.en: For example, learning more structured and editable captioning schemas through meta-learning could improve controllability and downstream editing flexibility, which we view as a promising direction for future work.
sents.zh: 例如，通过元学习来学习更结构化、更可编辑的描述模式，可以提高可控性和下游编辑的灵活性，我们将此视为未来工作的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: This work can provide positive societal impacts by improving the controllability of video generative models, which benefits applications such as content creation, media production, and simulation. In particular, enabling reconstruction-aware inverse prompting may reduce the manual trial-and-error process currently required for prompt engineering, improving accessibility and efficiency for non-expert users. At the same time, the framework could potentially be misused to facilitate unauthorized reproduction or manipulation of generated media, including malicious editing through video generation pipelines. Furthermore, recovering prompts from videos may raise concerns regarding intellectual property when applied to proprietary or copyrighted generative content. While our work focuses on improving controllable generation workflows rather than bypassing model safeguards or recovering hidden prompts exactly, we acknowledge these potential risks and encourage future research on responsible deployment, access control, and misuse monitoring for inverse prompting systems.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作可以通过提升视频生成模型的可控性带来积极的社会影响，从而惠及内容创作、媒体制作和仿真等应用。 特别是，实现具备重建感知的反向提示（inverse prompting）可以减少目前提示工程所需的人工反复试错过程，提高非专业用户的使用可及性和效率。 与此同时，该框架可能被滥用以促成对生成媒体的未授权复制或篡改，包括通过视频生成流程进行的恶意编辑。 此外，从视频中恢复提示词在应用于专有或受版权保护的生成内容时，可能引发知识产权方面的担忧。 虽然我们的工作重点是改进可控生成流程，而非绕过模型安全防护或精确恢复隐藏的提示词，但我们承认这些潜在风险，并鼓励未来针对反向提示系统的负责任部署、访问控制与滥用监测开展研究。

paragraphs.en: ARPO-based refinement. ARPO [ 50 ] proposes an iterative feedback-and-rewrite strategy for image reverse prompting, where a prompt is refined by comparing the generated image with the reference image and using the resulting feedback to update the prompt. To adapt this idea to video reverse prompting, we introduce a Captioning+Refine baseline. Starting from a VLM-generated caption using the instruction “Describe this video in detail,” we generate an initial reconstruction video. We then uniformly sample frames from both the target video segment and the generated video, and ask Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct to describe their concrete visual and motion differences. The resulting feedback is passed to GPT-4o-mini, which rewrites the current video prompt while preserving its correct content and structure. The refined prompt is then used to regenerate the video under the same first-last-frame conditioning and generation protocol as MVIP. To analyze the test-time refinement behavior of a caption-based baseline, we apply this refinement procedure only to the Captioning baseline and compare its iteration-wise performance with MVIP.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 ARPO 的精炼方法。 ARPO [50] 提出了一种用于图像反向提示的迭代反馈与重写策略，其中通过比较生成图像与参考图像，并利用所得反馈来更新提示，从而对提示进行精炼。 为了将这一思想适配到视频反向提示中，我们引入了 Captioning+Refine 基线。 我们首先使用指令「请详细描述这个视频」让视觉语言模型生成一段描述，并据此生成一个初始重建视频。 然后我们从目标视频片段和生成视频中均匀采样帧，并让 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 描述两者在具体视觉内容和运动上的差异。 所得反馈被传递给 GPT-4o-mini，由其在保留正确内容和结构的前提下重写当前的视频提示。 精炼后的提示随后被用于在与 MVIP 相同的首尾帧条件和生成协议下重新生成视频。 为了分析基于描述的基线的测试时精炼行为，我们仅将该精炼流程应用于 Captioning 基线，并将其逐次迭代的性能与 MVIP 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the full meta-training procedure of MVIP. At each outer iteration, we sample a batch of video tasks and perform task-specific inner-loop adaptation using Best-of- N N prompt sampling and reconstruction-based selection. The resulting task-adapted soft prompts are then aggregated through a Reptile-style update, yielding a meta-learned initialization that can be reused for video inverse prompting.
paragraphs.zh: 算法1总结了MVIP的完整元训练流程。 在每次外层迭代中，我们采样一批视频任务，并使用Best-of-N N提示采样和基于重构的选择来执行任务特定的内环适应。 随后通过Reptile风格的更新聚合得到的任务适应软提示，产生一个可复用于视频反向提示的元学习初始化。

paragraphs.en: We further compare MVIP with an iterative caption refinement baseline adapted from ARPO [ 50 ] . ARPO refines an image prompt by comparing the target image with the generated image and using the observed discrepancies as feedback for the next prompt. To extend this idea to videos, we sample multiple frames from both the target video and the generated video at matched temporal positions. A VLM is then asked to compare the two sets of frames and identify missing or mismatched visual details, including objects, scene layout, background appearance, motion cues, and temporal changes. The captioning baseline is rewritten using this feedback, and the updated caption is used to generate the next video. We repeat this process for three refinement iterations. Results are reported on the full evaluation set of Table 1 , aggregated over the synthetic and real-world splits. Table 10 shows that ARPO-style refinement improves the captioning baseline from iteration 0 to iteration 3 on most reported metrics. However, even after three refinement iterations, the refined baseline remains below MVIP at iteration 0 across all metrics. This indicates that test-time caption refinement helps the captioning baseline, but is not sufficient to match the reconstruction quality of our meta-learned inverse prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将 MVIP 与一种改编自 ARPO [50] 的迭代式字幕优化基线进行比较。 ARPO 通过将目标图像与生成图像进行比较，并将观察到的差异作为下一次提示的反馈，来优化图像提示。 为了将这一思想扩展到视频，我们从目标视频和生成视频中在匹配的时间位置上采样多帧。 然后要求 VLM 比较这两组帧，并识别缺失或不匹配的视觉细节，包括物体、场景布局、背景外观、运动线索和时间变化。 字幕生成基线会根据该反馈进行改写，更新后的字幕被用于生成下一个视频。 我们将此过程重复三次优化迭代。 结果在表 1 的完整评估集上报告，并在合成与真实世界两个划分上汇总。 表 10 显示，ARPO 式的优化在大多数报告指标上使字幕生成基线从第 0 次迭代提升到第 3 次迭代。 然而，即使经过三次优化迭代，优化后的基线在所有指标上仍低于第 0 次迭代的 MVIP。 这表明测试时的字幕优化有助于字幕生成基线，但不足以匹敌我们通过元学习得到的逆向提示的重建质量。

paragraphs.en: We follow the evaluation metrics of IVEBench [ 12 ] : Instruction Satisfaction (IS), Phrase Semantic Consistency (PSC), Overall Semantic Consistency (OSC), Subject Consistency (SC), Background Consistency (BC), Temporal Flickering (TF), Motion Smoothness (MS), Video Training Suitability Score (VTSS), Content Fidelity (CF), and Semantic Fidelity (SF). We evaluate all 64 Subject Motion Editing instances from the Short subset. All methods receive the same source video and edit instruction. RF-Edit [ 61 ] and Wan-Edit [ 30 ] additionally use the benchmark source and target prompts required by their respective editing pipelines. For MVIP, given a source video, we first recover a reconstruction-oriented inverse prompt and minimally rewrite it according to the edit instruction using GPT-4o [ 24 ] . We then apply an additional GPT-4o verification pass to ensure that the requested motion is reflected in the rewritten prompt, revising it if necessary. The edited prompt and only the first frame of the source video are then used for video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 IVEBench [12] 的评估指标：指令满足度（IS）、短语语义一致性（PSC）、整体语义一致性（OSC）、主体一致性（SC）、背景一致性（BC）、时序闪烁（TF）、运动平滑度（MS）、视频训练适用性得分（VTSS）、内容保真度（CF）和语义保真度（SF）。 我们对 Short 子集中的全部 64 个主体运动编辑实例进行评估。 所有方法都接收相同的源视频和编辑指令。 RF-Edit [61] 和 Wan-Edit [30] 额外使用其各自编辑流程所要求的基准源提示词和目标提示词。 对于 MVIP，给定一个源视频，我们首先恢复一个面向重建的逆向提示词，并使用 GPT-4o [24] 根据编辑指令对其进行最小限度的改写。 然后我们再进行一次额外的 GPT-4o 验证，以确保所请求的运动体现在改写后的提示词中，并在必要时进行修订。 编辑后的提示词与源视频仅有的第一帧随后被用于视频生成。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the generated videos using VBench [ 23 ] , which measures reference-free video generation quality along multiple dimensions, including subject consistency, background consistency, temporal flickering, motion smoothness, and dynamic degree. As shown in Table 15 , MVIP achieves the best or competitive scores across most dimensions on both real and synthetic videos. In particular, MVIP achieves the highest background consistency on both splits and the highest subject consistency on synthetic videos, while remaining competitive on real videos, suggesting that the recovered prompts help maintain coherent subject appearance and scene context during generation. While Captioning+Refine slightly improves flicker and motion smoothness in some cases, MVIP maintains strong temporal quality while producing more semantically consistent videos. These results suggest that the proposed inverse prompts improve reconstruction-oriented alignment without sacrificing general video quality.

paragraphs.en: We further examine the effect of the learned soft prompt Φ \Phi in Figure 8 . When sampled without the learned Φ \Phi , i.e. , the target VLM is conditioned only on the manually written hard meta-prompt, the generated prompt mainly captures the coarse action while omitting details about the subject, scene context, and temporal progression. With Φ \Phi , on the other hand, the prompt significantly better specifies the subject’s appearance, the surrounding environment, and how the motion unfolds over time. This comparison shows that Φ \Phi acts as a learned prompt prior, steering the VLM toward visual and temporal cues that are useful for the video inversion process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 8 中进一步检验了学习到的软提示 Φ \Phi 的效果。 当在没有学习到的 Φ \Phi 的情况下进行采样时，即目标 VLM 仅以手工编写的硬元提示（hard meta-prompt）为条件，生成的提示主要捕捉粗略动作，而忽略了关于主体、场景上下文以及时间推进的细节。 另一方面，有了 Φ \Phi 后，提示能够显著更好地描述主体的外观、周围环境，以及运动随时间展开的方式。 这一对比表明，Φ \Phi 起到了学习到的提示先验的作用，引导 VLM 关注对视频反演过程有用的视觉与时间线索。

sents.en: We further examine the effect of the learned soft prompt Φ \Phi in Figure 8 .
sents.zh: 我们在图 8 中进一步检验了学习到的软提示 Φ \Phi 的效果。

sents.en: When sampled without the learned Φ \Phi , i.e. , the target VLM is conditioned only on the manually written hard meta-prompt, the generated prompt mainly captures the coarse action while omitting details about the subject, scene context, and temporal progression.
sents.zh: 当在没有学习到的 Φ \Phi 的情况下进行采样时，即目标 VLM 仅以手工编写的硬元提示（hard meta-prompt）为条件，生成的提示主要捕捉粗略动作，而忽略了关于主体、场景上下文以及时间推进的细节。

sents.en: With Φ \Phi , on the other hand, the prompt significantly better specifies the subject’s appearance, the surrounding environment, and how the motion unfolds over time.
sents.zh: 另一方面，有了 Φ \Phi 后，提示能够显著更好地描述主体的外观、周围环境，以及运动随时间展开的方式。

sents.en: This comparison shows that Φ \Phi acts as a learned prompt prior, steering the VLM toward visual and temporal cues that are useful for the video inversion process.
sents.zh: 这一对比表明，Φ \Phi 起到了学习到的提示先验的作用，引导 VLM 关注对视频反演过程有用的视觉与时间线索。

paragraphs.en: To better understand what the learned soft prompt encodes, we perform a qualitative analysis following the soft-prompt-to-instruction conversion used in InstructZero [ 10 ] . For each checkpoint, we provide the soft prompt together with the same set of video–caption input-output examples and ask an LLM to infer the underlying instruction. As shown in Table 17 , the decoded outputs evolve from a generic clarification request to a task-specific description of video captioning, suggesting that the soft prompt gradually acquires task-level semantics during meta-training. These outputs should be viewed as approximate interpretations rather than exact discrete inversions of the soft prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地理解学习到的软提示编码了什么，我们遵循 InstructZero [10] 中使用的软提示到指令的转换方法进行定性分析。 对于每个检查点，我们提供软提示以及同一组视频–字幕输入-输出示例，并让一个大语言模型推断其背后的指令。 如表 17 所示，解码得到的输出从泛化的澄清请求逐渐演变为对视频字幕任务的具体描述，这表明软提示在元训练过程中逐渐获得了任务级语义。 这些输出应被视为近似的解释，而非对软提示的精确离散求逆。
